name: Egyptian Goose
description: The Egyptian Goose is a sturdy waterbird with long pinkish legs, a pale head, and a distinctive dark patch around each eye. Native to Africa, it has also established populations elsewhere. It uses open landscapes near lakes, rivers, and ponds, feeding mainly on grasses, seeds, and other plant material. Much feeding takes place on land or in very shallow water. The contrast between its patterned head and broad, pale wing areas is especially noticeable when it stretches or flies.

references.title: Cornell Lab of Ornithology: All About Birds
